sections.text:
[Effects]
The following will activate if your Class is Lancer:
Increases physical and magic Ability Power by XXS.
Performs a critical hit.
Ability Power scales with the number of Wind elemental Lance/Scythe type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 10).

[Activation]
When a physical or magic attack Ability is used.
Only activates when playing as Lancer.

[Activation Rate]
M
Activation rate scales with the number of Wind elemental Lance/Scythe type Gear pieces equipped up to a max of XL (Gear pieces needed for maximum effect: 10).
